request.utterance: SUE-570 파일럿: 같은 글을 10~12살 아이가 읽을 수 있게 설명글로 각색해줘. 지식 수준은 낮추되 '이건 확실한 사실이 아니라 생각'이라는 부분은 절대 지우지 마. 그림 하나, 글자 없이.

transformation.basis: utterance asks to re-render an existing piece for a different reader/reading level rather than synthesize new material — same sense used in schemas/examples/intent-child-explainer.example.json. Recorded honestly: adapt.json's own definition and typical examples center on cross-medium modality change (text to audio/slides); this run applies it to a same-medium (text-to-text), age-driven complexity change instead. This tension is recorded as a feedback candidate at feedback/records/sue570-pilot-source-a-adapt-axis-scope-2026-09-05.json, not silently resolved here. (CORRECTION, independent review, 2026-09-05: this previously pointed at evals/dogfood/2026-09-05-sue570-pilot/source-a/05-feedback/, a directory that does not exist and was never created.)

content_type.basis: a short child-facing explainer derived from one existing published piece carries a lighter evidence burden than the source's own content type (view); note.json fits and nothing in the utterance argues for a heavier content type. Mirrors schemas/examples/intent-child-explainer.example.json's same resolution.

audience.basis: utterance says "10~12살" (ages 10-12) explicitly, matching audience/child-upper-elementary.json's stated age range exactly — the named profile per docs/architecture/V2-EDITORIAL-LEARNING-CORE.md §12, not a softened adult preset.

surface.basis: no new destination was named; this pilot's own task brief places all three variants in the same suengj-com editorial draft lane as the news and report variants.

artifacts.basis: utterance asks for a rewritten explainer text; text/article is the planned text-artifact id in editorial/profiles/axes.json.

utterance says "그림 하나, 글자 없이" (one picture, no text) — matches visual/concept-illustration.json's text_policy.profile: no_text and its explicit child-upper-elementary audience_adaptation calling for a literal, concrete depiction over schematic abstraction, unlike the body-infographic the audience profile flags as inappropriate by default for a genuinely child-targeted piece.

sources.note: The canonical, already-published (status: published) source. Not modified by this pilot. answer.claims (c1, c2, c3, kind: interpretation) is the factual-integrity baseline — the utterance's own constraint ('이건 확실한 사실이 아니라 생각'이라는 부분은 절대 지우지 마') restates exactly what recreate/adapt's must_preserve already requires: stated uncertainty is preserved even as knowledge level drops (audience/child-upper-elementary.json anti_patterns).
